Missing retained tool refuses before materials or transaction change

A retained tool alone cannot manufacture a third rig
Actual first entry consumes one produced rig and starts Crossing
Active encounter cannot craft away its supply boundary
Repeated entry cannot consume another rig during the same encounter
Actual survey win is not final Crossing completion
Survey redraw cannot spend second rig or invent final arrival
Explicit second entry consumes the second actual produced rig
Actual final encounter completes with both rigs spent and gauge retained
Completion cannot grant a free further entry
Completion does not restore ingredients or production
Actual losing encounter does not refund the crafted and consumed rig
A failed consumed rig cannot be reused without actual new production
Accepted replacement trial discards older queued crafting intent
Isolated false-tool renderer is detected against actual missing-tool owner
Actual browser has no uncaught script errors
Current consumer and unchanged referenced source identities remain exact
